description.en:
Realism — a script-only mod that strips away arcade conveniences and forces you to live with the consequences of farm life.
This mod focuses on authenticity. No new vehicles, no new buildings, no flashy textures — just gameplay changes that make Farming Simulator 25 feel like real work.
Features:
- Realism intro (new games) When you begin a brand-new save, a short intro explains the rules you signed up for. Your starting money, starting vehicle and starting field are left to whatever the map / career preset you picked provides — the mod no longer changes them. Existing saves are never touched.
- Disabled teleporting You can no longer press Tab or Shift+Tab to switch between vehicles, you can't jump into a vehicle picked from the in-game map unless you are standing right next to it, and the map's "Visit" / "Go To" option for fields and buildings no longer teleports you. To get anywhere you have to physically walk or drive there. Plan your routes, park sensibly, and respect the distance — like a real farmer would.
- Seasonal greenhouse production Greenhouses no longer produce at a constant rate. Output scales with the time of year and the current weather: * Summer = 100% (baseline) * Spring / Fall = 75% * Winter = 50% * Sunny weather adds +20% * Rain reduces output by 10%, snow by 30%, hail by 40% Plan your winter cash flow accordingly.
- Inflation Like the real economy, prices drift up over time. Every year a random inflation rate between 1.5% and 5.5% is set and held for that whole year, compounding across years. It applies to BOTH buying and selling — inputs, fuel and machinery get pricier, but crops and goods are also worth more. That means you can invest: store wheat now and sell it years later at a higher, inflated price. The current year's rate is announced on screen.
- Production store-only (no auto-sell or auto-distribute) Production buildings can no longer automatically sell or distribute their output. Every product is forced to "store" mode and piles up in the building's storage. To turn it into money you must drive a trailer over, load the goods, and haul them to a sell point or another production yourself. Manage your own supply chain.
- Bulk trade bonuses Moving goods in volume pays off, like a real wholesale deal. * Selling: the more you sell in one go, the bigger the bonus on top of the price. Starts at +1% once a sale reaches 25,000 litres and ramps to +10% at 100,000 litres or more. * Buying: filling up on fertilizer, lime, seeds, herbicide or fuel in bulk earns a discount. Starts at -1% from 1,000 litres and ramps to -8% at 10,000 litres or more.
- Balancer (locked realism settings) Realism-critical game settings can't be softened. Economy difficulty is forced to Normal (no Easy), and traffic, seasonal growth, snow, crop destruction, periodical plowing, required lime, weeds and disasters are all forced on. Change them in the menu and they revert automatically. Field stones are the exception: they are turned off by default when you start a new game, but you are free to switch them back on and they will stay on. AI helpers also never auto-buy fuel, seeds, fertilizer or manure/slurry — you have to refill their vehicles yourself.
- AI crop damage Hired workers no longer get a free pass over your crops. Like you, an AI vehicle running the wrong (non row-crop) tyres flattens crops and leaves tracks as it drives — so tyre choice matters for helpers too.
- Sleep schedule Sleeping is only allowed from 21:00 — no napping through the day to skip it — unless you are already tired. After 16 hours awake you get tired (a warning, a short fade-to-black and a yawn sound), and once tired you can sleep at any time to recover. Sleeping less than 6 hours leaves you sleep-deprived and still tired, so you need a proper rest to fully recover.
- Chainsaw stump removal No more permanent stumps littering your forest. After felling a tree, cut into the leftover stump with the chainsaw and it is removed — clean up your woodland with the tool you already have, no expensive stump grinder needed.
More realism features will be added in future updates, each as a self-contained module that can be enabled or disabled independently.
Compatibility: - Singleplayer: fully supported - Multiplayer: fully supported - Other mods: no conflicts expected (does not modify vehicles, maps, or fillTypes)
If you want Farming Simulator 25 to feel less like a game and more like a job, this is the mod for you.

text.name: realism_intro_body
text.en: This mod makes farming authentic and hard. No teleporting, real sleep, inflation, no auto-selling, locked realism settings. Your starting money, vehicle and field are whatever the map you picked gives you — build your farm from there, the hard way.
